============================================================================
OmniBuf-PHP Benchmark Suite (PHP 8.6.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (365B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 2,731 ns | 366,170 | 365 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 2,753 ns | 363,192 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 87,250 ns | 11,461 | 341 | 31.95x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 1,418 ns | 705,162 | 803 | 1.93x faster |

### 2. Full Message Decode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 2,890 ns | 345,989 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 2,902 ns | 344,533 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 51,102 ns | 19,569 | 17.68x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 4,931 ns | 202,793 | 1.71x slower |

### 3. Read a Single Nested Field

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 516 ns | 1,938,248 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 47,483 ns | 21,060 | 92.02x slower |
| json_decode (stdlib) | 3,700 ns | 270,255 | 7.17x slower |

### 4. Selective Single-Field Mutation

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 1,500 ns | 666,527 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 138,241 ns | 7,234 | 92.16x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 5,131 ns | 194,900 | 3.42x slower |

### 5. Large Embedded Message Encode

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 6,995 ns | 142,966 | 39255 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (Attributes) | 6,994 ns | 142,984 | 39256 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,169,536 ns | 855 | 39227 | 167.20x slower |
| json_encode (stdlib) | 23,175 ns | 43,149 | 39681 | 3.31x slower |

### 6. Embedded Message Growth

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 4,495 ns | 222,482 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| google/protobuf (pure PHP) | 1,161,962 ns | 861 | 258.50x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 31,253 ns | 31,997 | 6.95x slower |
